summary: Split hero after MicroSourcing and Horatio. Left: the headline, lead and a short question (for example 'What can we help you with?') above 3-6 service chips that link to the page's sections, then a full-width button; by default all of it sits in a large dark rounded card ("card": false puts it plain on the page). Right: one real person photo cropped into a large circle on a brand-colour disc, with a thick accent arc that draws once on load and 2-3 small stat stickers around the edge that pop in one after another. No loops. Needs one real photo of a person (a smiling team member works best); suits staffing, contact center and multi-service companies.
